meaning: The comment documents the default solver time-step cap ladder for the dtmax sweep script (free, 0.5, 0.1, 0.05, 0.01 s), which is the list of caps solved when _DTMAX_VALUES is unset. It is a claim about the script's defaults, not about physiology.

could_move.what: The per-cap outputs and manifest.csv diagnostics written under sweep_dtmax/<stamp>/ — which dtmax_<value>.h5 files exist at all depends on this default list
The pulsatile twin solves, since one is run per swept cap value

expectation: Unknown from this context. The comment itself changes nothing when solved; the risk is that it disagrees with the actual default in the code, so a reader assumes caps that were never solved. Whether the ladder reaches a converged step is not visible here.

check.why: Reads the actual default cap list out of the script and compares it to the number stated in the comment, with no solve.
